name: C1 — Advanced
description: Operate in Mandarin for business, academic, and journalistic contexts. Argue a position, structure formal discourse, and use 成语 with confidence.

guide.intro: Business Mandarin lives in a register far above everyday speech. The same idea you'd say with 因为...所以 over coffee gets dressed up with 鉴于... 因此 in a meeting. Three habits define the register: connectives that tie clauses together, nominalized topics with 至于, and a default to 您 / 贵 honorifics.

sections.text: Formal causal connectives

Casual Chinese uses 因为 X 所以 Y. In formal writing and meetings, you upgrade to 鉴于 X，因此 Y ("in view of X, therefore Y") or 由于 X，故 Y ("owing to X, hence Y"). 因此 and 故 are interchangeable for "therefore", but 故 sounds bookish.

rows.source: 鉴于市场环境的变化，我们因此调整了战略。
rows.pinyin: Jiànyú shìchǎng huánjìng de biànhuà, wǒmen yīncǐ tiáozhěng le zhànlüè.
rows.translation: In view of market changes, we have therefore adjusted our strategy.

rows.source: 由于成本上升，公司因此决定提价。
rows.pinyin: Yóuyú chéngběn shàngshēng, gōngsī yīncǐ juédìng tíjià.
rows.translation: Owing to rising costs, the company has accordingly decided to raise prices.

rows.source: 因为成本上升，所以我们涨价了。
rows.pinyin: Yīnwèi chéngběn shàngshēng, suǒyǐ wǒmen zhǎngjià le.
rows.translation: Because costs rose, we raised prices. (casual)

sections.text: 然而 vs 但是 — "however"
但是 works in any register. 然而 is the formal cousin you reach for in reports, op-eds, and presentations. 不过 sits in between — written Chinese friendly but not stiff.

rows: Strong contrast in essays, news, reports.

sections.text: 至于 — topic shift

至于 X ("as for X") moves the spotlight to a new sub-topic and is heavily used in structured talks. The phrase always introduces a fresh clause and is followed by a comma. Think of it as the spoken equivalent of a slide transition.

rows.source: 营收方面我们超出预期。至于成本，仍需进一步控制。
rows.pinyin: Yíngshōu fāngmiàn wǒmen chāochū yùqī. Zhìyú chéngběn, réng xū jìnyībù kòngzhì.
rows.translation: On revenue we exceeded expectations. As for costs, they still need to be controlled further.

rows.source: 至于您提到的合作方式，我们下周再深入讨论。
rows.pinyin: Zhìyú nín tídào de hézuò fāngshì, wǒmen xiàzhōu zài shēnrù tǎolùn.
rows.translation: As for the form of cooperation you mentioned, let us discuss it in depth next week.

sections.text: 贵 — honorific prefix

贵 ("honored") attaches to nouns referring to the other party's affiliations: 贵公司 (your company), 贵校 (your school), 贵姓 (your honored surname). Use 贵 anywhere a respectful tone is owed; in return, refer to your own side with the humble 敝 (敝公司 "my humble company") or simply 我方 ("our side").
Mixing registers will make you sound off. Once you open a meeting with 贵公司, stay in formal mode: keep using 您, swap 但是 for 然而, and lean on 至于 for transitions.

lessons.title: Opening a meeting
lessons.description: Greet, thank, and frame the agenda

exercises.prompt: What does "承蒙贵公司的支持" (chéng méng guì gōngsī de zhīchí) mean?
exercises.answer: Thanks to your company's support
exercises.explanation: 承蒙 is a formal "thanks to / kindly receiving"; 贵公司 is the honorific "your company".

exercises.prompt: Build "Today's agenda mainly covers three items"
exercises.answer: 今天 的 议程 主要 包括 三 项 内容

exercises.prompt: the formal opener to its function

pairs.right: Thanks for taking time to attend

pairs.left: 请允许我做个简单的介绍
pairs.right: Allow me to make a brief introduction
Let's begin with item one on the agenda
I hope we can reach consensus today

exercises.prompt: "贵公司" is the formal way to say ___
exercises.answer: Your company
exercises.explanation: The 贵 honorific elevates references to the other party.

exercises.prompt: Spot the register mismatch — which sentence sounds wrong because a casual word slipped into a formal opener?
options: 感谢各位拨冗出席今天的会议
感谢大家抽空来开个会
感谢各位拨冗出席这次破会
尊敬的各位嘉宾，欢迎莅临
exercises.answer: 感谢各位拨冗出席这次破会
exercises.explanation: 拨冗出席 is formal; 破会 ("crap meeting") is dismissive slang. The casual second option is internally consistent; the third option mixes a stiff opener with a slur. The other two stay in register.

exercises.prompt: the meeting role to its Chinese title
Build "Allow me on behalf of the company to extend a warm welcome to everyone"
exercises.answer: 请 允许 我 代表 公司 对 各位 表示 热烈 的 欢迎

exercises.prompt: Tap the honorific pronoun you hear
exercises.answer: 请问您贵姓
exercises.explanation: 您 (formal) versus 你 (neutral) is the C1 register dial. 贵姓 ("honored surname") only pairs with 您.

exercises.prompt: Which transition best opens the agenda after greetings?
options: 下面我们进入正式议程
exercises.answer: 下面我们进入正式议程
exercises.explanation: 进入正式议程 ("enter the formal agenda") is the standard transition. The others either drop register or sound dictatorial.

exercises.prompt: Complete the formal opener: "今天的会议主要 ___ 三项议程" (mainly covers)
exercises.answer: 包括
exercises.explanation: 包括 ("includes") is the neutral choice. 涉及 ("touches on") and 围绕 ("revolves around") also work depending on emphasis.

exercises.prompt: Build "In view of the tight schedule today, please make your remarks concise"
exercises.answer: 鉴于 今天 时间 紧迫 ， 请 各位 发言 尽量 简短

exercises.prompt: Which is the closest near-synonym distinction at C1?
options: 我认为 (current view) ≠ 我以为 (mistaken prior view)
exercises.answer: 我认为 (current view) ≠ 我以为 (mistaken prior view)
exercises.explanation: 我以为 implies the speaker has been corrected. 我认为 is a current claim. Mishearing one for the other inverts the message.

lessons.title: Negotiation language
lessons.description: Soften, push back, propose terms

exercises.prompt: Which phrase most diplomatically rejects a proposal?
options: 恐怕这个方案我们难以接受
exercises.answer: 恐怕这个方案我们难以接受
exercises.explanation: 恐怕 ("I'm afraid") + 难以接受 ("hard to accept") softens the rejection while staying firm.

exercises.prompt: Build "On the price issue we hope you can reconsider"
exercises.answer: 在 价格 问题 上 我们 希望 贵方 可以 再 考虑 一下

exercises.prompt: What does "双方各让一步" (shuāngfāng gè ràng yí bù) suggest?
exercises.answer: Each side makes a concession
exercises.explanation: Literally "both sides each yield one step" — classic negotiation phrasing for a compromise.

exercises.prompt: "我们的底线" (wǒmen de dǐ xiàn) means "our ___"
exercises.answer: Bottom line
exercises.explanation: 底线 = bottom line, the lowest acceptable terms.

exercises.prompt: the negotiation move to its Chinese phrase
Pick the supplier-negotiation phrasing that signals a willingness to compromise without giving up leverage:
options: 在数量上我们可以让步，但单价必须维持
你们说什么我们都同意
这个条件我们绝对不接受，不用谈了
exercises.answer: 在数量上我们可以让步，但单价必须维持
exercises.explanation: Concede on volume, hold the unit price — classic negotiation move expressed in formal Mandarin.

exercises.prompt: Build "In view of the long-term partnership, we are willing to make appropriate concessions on the payment terms"
exercises.answer: 鉴于 长期 合作 关系 ， 我方 愿意 在 付款 条件 上 做出 适当 让步

exercises.prompt: Tap the formality marker you hear in the negotiation reply
exercises.spokenText: 目前我们希望贵方再考虑一下
options: 目前我们希望贵方再考虑一下
现在我们想你们再考虑一下
目前我们希望你方再考虑一下
exercises.answer: 目前我们希望贵方再考虑一下
exercises.explanation: 目前 (formal "currently") + 希望 (formal "hope") + 贵方 ("your honorable side") all align in register. Listening for 现在/目前 and 你方/贵方 catches register at speed.

exercises.prompt: What does "达成共识" (dá chéng gòng shí) mean?
exercises.answer: Reach a consensus
exercises.explanation: 达成 ("reach") + 共识 ("shared understanding") — standard meeting outcome language.

exercises.prompt: Complete: "双方在主要条款上已经 ___ 共识" (have reached)
exercises.answer: 达成
exercises.explanation: 达成共识 / 达成协议 — fixed business collocations.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence transforms casual "我觉得这个价格太贵了" into formal supplier-negotiation register?
options: 我方认为该报价偏高，希望贵方能予以调整
你这个价格也太贵了吧
exercises.answer: 我方认为该报价偏高，希望贵方能予以调整
exercises.explanation: 我方 / 该报价 / 予以调整 are all formal upgrades of 我们/这个价格/改一下.

lessons.title: Formal email & letters
lessons.description: Salutations, body, and sign-offs

exercises.prompt: the email element to its position

pairs.left: 兹就贵公司提出的方案，回复如下

exercises.prompt: What does "兹" (zī) mean in formal email?
exercises.answer: Hereby / herewith
exercises.explanation: 兹 is a classical-style word still used in formal correspondence to mean "hereby".

exercises.prompt: Build "Attached please find the contract draft, please kindly review"
exercises.answer: 附件 是 合同 草稿 敬请 查阅

exercises.prompt: "此致 敬礼" closes a Chinese formal letter, equivalent to ___
exercises.answer: Sincerely
exercises.explanation: Standard formal sign-off; literally "to here, salute".

exercises.prompt: What does "敬请查阅" mean in a formal email?
exercises.answer: Please kindly review
exercises.explanation: 敬请 ("respectfully request") + 查阅 ("check / read") — fixed honorific request.

exercises.prompt: Spot the register mismatch in this formal email body:
options: 兹就贵公司提出的方案，我方回复如下
兹就贵公司的提案，我方答复如下
兹就你们那个方案，我方回复如下
关于贵公司的方案，我方答复如下
exercises.answer: 兹就你们那个方案，我方回复如下
exercises.explanation: 兹/我方 are classical-register formal; 你们那个方案 is colloquial pointing language. Mixing them sounds jarring; the other three keep register internally consistent.

exercises.prompt: Build the formal email line "In view of the contract you provided, we hereby reply as follows"
exercises.answer: 鉴于 贵方 提供 的 合同 ， 兹 回复 如下

exercises.prompt: the email element to its Chinese standard line

pairs.right: 主题：关于合同条款的回复
兹就贵公司提出的方案，回复如下

exercises.prompt: Tap the salutation register you hear
exercises.answer: 尊敬的王总您好
exercises.explanation: 尊敬的 + 您 = consistently formal. The 你/您 swap downgrades register; 亲爱的 sounds personal; 啊 is colloquial.

exercises.prompt: Convert casual "麻烦你看一下" into formal email language: "敬请 ___"
exercises.answer: 查阅
exercises.explanation: 敬请查阅/审阅/过目 are interchangeable formal requests for the recipient to read.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence appropriately confirms attachment delivery in formal register?
options: 附件中是合同草稿，请贵方审阅
我把合同贴在下面了，看一下
exercises.answer: 附件中是合同草稿，请贵方审阅
exercises.explanation: 附件中 + 贵方 + 审阅 = formal alignment. The other three slide into casual or commanding tone.

lessons.title: Discussing performance
lessons.description: Numbers, growth, projections

exercises.prompt: "营收同比增长百分之十五" means revenue grew ___
exercises.answer: 15% year-over-year
exercises.explanation: 同比 specifically means "compared with the same period last year". 环比 = quarter-over-quarter / period-over-period.

exercises.prompt: Build "This quarter's profit is significantly higher than expected"
exercises.answer: 本 季度 的 利润 远 高于 预期

exercises.prompt: the term to its meaning
"扭亏为盈" describes a company turning ___
exercises.answer: Loss into profit
exercises.explanation: 扭亏为盈 (niǔ kuī wéi yíng) — a fixed business expression for becoming profitable.

exercises.prompt: Tap the comparison metric you hear
exercises.answer: 同比增长百分之十五
exercises.explanation: 同比 (year-over-year) and 环比 (period-over-period) sound and look alike but mean different things. Train your ear to hear 同 vs 环.

exercises.prompt: the KPI term to its meaning
What does "营收同比增长百分之十五，环比下降百分之三" mean?
options: Revenue rose 15% year-over-year but fell 3% quarter-over-quarter
Revenue rose 15% this quarter and 3% next quarter
exercises.answer: Revenue rose 15% year-over-year but fell 3% quarter-over-quarter
exercises.explanation: Mixed-direction comparisons in earnings are routine. 同比 = vs same period last year; 环比 = vs prior period.

exercises.prompt: Build "In view of falling profit margin, the company is therefore strengthening cost control"
exercises.answer: 鉴于 利润率 下降 ， 公司 因此 加强 成本 控制

exercises.prompt: Tap the figure you hear
exercises.answer: 营业额突破十亿
exercises.explanation: C1 listening trains your ear for big numbers. 十亿 = 1 billion; 一亿 = 100 million; 十万 = 100,000.

exercises.prompt: Complete: "本季度净利润 ___ 上季度增长百分之八" (compared with last quarter)
exercises.answer: 较
exercises.explanation: 较 X 增长 Y is the formal earnings-report frame. 比 also works in neutral register.

exercises.prompt: Which forecast hedge is the most cautious?
options: 我们一定超额完成目标
我们应该可以完成目标
exercises.answer: 我们有望完成目标
exercises.explanation: 有望 ("there is hope") is the standard analyst-grade hedge. 一定 / 必将 are over-confident; 应该可以 is conversational.

exercises.prompt: the financial trend phrase to its meaning

lessons.title: Closing & follow-up
lessons.description: Wrapping the meeting and confirming next steps

exercises.prompt: Build "Thank you all for your valuable input"
exercises.answer: 感谢 各位 提出 的 宝贵 意见

exercises.prompt: Which best translates "We'll follow up by email next week"?
options: 下周我们再用邮件跟进
exercises.answer: 下周我们再用邮件跟进
exercises.explanation: 跟进 ("follow up") is a borrowed business term in modern Chinese.

exercises.prompt: the closing phrase to its meaning

pairs.right: Looking forward to working together again

exercises.prompt: "双赢" (shuāng yíng) means a ___ outcome
exercises.answer: Win-win
exercises.explanation: 双赢 is the modern business calque from English "win-win".

exercises.prompt: Build "In view of recent market volatility, the company is therefore postponing its IPO"
exercises.answer: 鉴于 近期 市场 波动 ， 公司 因此 暂缓 上市

exercises.prompt: What does "会议纪要将于会后一周内发出" mean?
options: Meeting minutes will be issued within a week after the meeting
The meeting will end within a week
Minutes are due before the meeting
The meeting will be held weekly
exercises.answer: Meeting minutes will be issued within a week after the meeting
exercises.explanation: 会议纪要 = meeting minutes; 会后一周内 = within a week after the meeting; 发出 = send out.

exercises.prompt: the contract-signing phrase
Build "Both parties confirm the contract will take effect on the date of signing"
exercises.answer: 双方 确认 合同 自 签署 之日 起 生效

exercises.prompt: Which closing line best reflects "a successful, win-win meeting"?
options: 今天的会议非常圆满，期待与贵方达成长期合作
今天就到这吧，下次再说
exercises.answer: 今天的会议非常圆满，期待与贵方达成长期合作
exercises.explanation: 圆满 ("perfectly concluded") + 期待 + 长期合作 = polished closing register.

exercises.prompt: Tap the follow-up plan you hear
exercises.spokenText: 下周三我们以邮件形式跟进
options: 下周三我们以邮件形式跟进
下周二我们以邮件形式跟进
下周三我们以电话形式跟进
下周三我们以会议形式跟进
exercises.answer: 下周三我们以邮件形式跟进
exercises.explanation: C1 listening tests fine details: 三 vs 二, 邮件 vs 电话 vs 会议. 以...形式 is formal "by means of".

exercises.prompt: Complete the formal close: "如有任何疑问，请随时与我方 ___" (contact)
exercises.answer: 联系
exercises.explanation: 联系 (contact) and 沟通 (communicate) both work; 联系 is more standard.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence transforms casual "我们之后再说吧" into proper meeting close-out?
options: 至于剩余事项，我们将在下次会议中进一步讨论
exercises.answer: 至于剩余事项，我们将在下次会议中进一步讨论
exercises.explanation: 至于 fronts a sub-topic; 剩余事项 / 进一步讨论 are formal upgrades of 剩下的事 / 再说.

turns.answer: 另一方面

turns.text: 明白了。下周提案务必把这两点写清楚。

guide.intro: Academic Chinese is dense, nominalized, and emphasis-heavy. Two structures dominate: 是...的 to spotlight one component of an established fact, and nominalization with 的 / 来说 / 而言 to package whole clauses as topics. Master these and your writing instantly sounds academic.

sections.text: 是...的 — emphasis on a known event

When the listener already knows the action happened and you want to highlight when, where, how, or who did it, wrap that element in 是...的. The 是 sits before the highlighted phrase; 的 closes the sentence.

rows.pinyin: Tā lái le.
rows.translation: He came. (neutral statement)

rows.pinyin: Tā shì zuótiān lái de.
rows.translation: It was yesterday that he came. (when)

rows.pinyin: Tā shì cóng Běijīng lái de.
rows.translation: It is from Beijing that he came. (where)

rows.pinyin: Zhè běn shū shì èr líng yī bā nián chūbǎn de.
rows.translation: This book was published in 2018. (focus on the year)

sections.text: 是...的 only works for events the listener already accepts as fact. If you're announcing fresh news, use 了 instead — 是...的 would sound oddly defensive.
Nominalization with 的话 / 来说 / 而言

Academic writing turns clauses into topic NPs. 对 X 来说 / 对 X 而言 means "as far as X is concerned". 就 X 而言 raises the formality further. These structures let you front a scoped premise before delivering an argument.

rows.source: 对发展中国家来说，气候变化是巨大的挑战。
rows.pinyin: Duì fāzhǎn zhōng guójiā lái shuō, qìhòu biànhuà shì jùdà de tiǎozhàn.
rows.translation: For developing countries, climate change is a huge challenge.

rows.source: 就经济效益而言，这个方案最为合理。
rows.pinyin: Jiù jīngjì xiàoyì ér yán, zhège fāng'àn zuì wéi hélǐ.
rows.translation: In terms of economic benefit, this plan is the most reasonable.

rows.source: 如果按这个标准的话，我们都不合格。
rows.pinyin: Rúguǒ àn zhège biāozhǔn de huà, wǒmen dōu bù hégé.
rows.translation: If we go by this standard, none of us qualify.

sections.text: Hedging your claims
Academic Chinese hedges constantly. 似乎 (it seems), 可能 (possibly), 在一定程度上 (to a certain extent), and 总的来说 (generally speaking) are the four pillars. Stack them to soften strong claims.
Citing and quoting

rows.pinyin: Gēnjù Wáng jiàoshòu de yánjiū…
rows.translation: According to Professor Wang's research…

rows.pinyin: Zhèngrú xuézhě suǒ zhǐchū de…
rows.translation: As scholars have pointed out…

rows.source: 数据显示，过去十年间增长了百分之四十。
rows.pinyin: Shùjù xiǎnshì, guòqù shí nián jiān zēngzhǎng le bǎi fēn zhī sìshí.
rows.translation: The data show that over the past decade it grew by 40%.

lessons.title: 是...的 emphasis
lessons.description: Highlight when, where, or how something happened

exercises.prompt: What does "她是去年从英国回来的" emphasize?
options: When and where she returned from
exercises.answer: When and where she returned from
exercises.explanation: 是...的 highlights the time (去年) and origin (从英国); the listener already knows she returned.

exercises.prompt: Build "This theory was first proposed by Einstein"
exercises.answer: 这个 理论 是 爱因斯坦 最早 提出 的

exercises.prompt: Pick the correct emphasis sentence for "It was in 1949 that the People's Republic was founded."
options: 中华人民共和国是1949年成立的
中华人民共和国1949年成立了
中华人民共和国成立1949年
中华人民共和国是1949年成立
exercises.answer: 中华人民共和国是1949年成立的
exercises.explanation: 是...的 frames 1949 as the focused year; the other options either drop 是, drop 的, or scramble the word order.

exercises.prompt: Pick the correct word: "这篇论文 ___ 王教授写的" (focus: who wrote it)
exercises.answer: 是
exercises.explanation: 是...的 fronts "by Professor Wang" as the focus. 被 would create a passive but mismatch with 的; 把 needs a disposed object after it; 在 marks location, not agent focus.

exercises.prompt: Build "This phenomenon was first discovered in the 19th century"
exercises.answer: 这 一 现象 是 在 十九 世纪 首次 被 发现 的

exercises.prompt: Convert casual "她昨天回来了" into 是...的 emphasis (focus on the time):
exercises.answer: 她是昨天回来的
exercises.explanation: 是 sits before the highlighted time; 的 closes the sentence. The other options break the frame.

exercises.prompt: the 是...的 sentence to what it emphasizes
Complete with the missing 的 closer: "该理论是上世纪七十年代提出 ___"
exercises.answer: 的
exercises.explanation: 是...的 always closes with 的 — a common omission error.

exercises.prompt: Tap the focus you hear
exercises.answer: 她是从美国回来的
exercises.explanation: 美 vs 英 is a one-tone listening swap. 是...的 vs 了 changes whether the sentence is emphasis-frame or fresh report.

exercises.prompt: Build the formal academic line "This finding was published in Nature last year"
exercises.answer: 这 一 发现 是 去年 在 《 自然 》 杂志 上 发表 的

exercises.prompt: Which version is correct emphasis for "It was Einstein who first proposed this theory"?
options: 这一理论是爱因斯坦最早提出的
爱因斯坦最早提出这一理论了
这一理论由爱因斯坦提出过
exercises.answer: 这一理论是爱因斯坦最早提出的
exercises.explanation: 是...的 frames 爱因斯坦 + 最早 as the focus. The other forms either drop 是/的 or scramble word order.

lessons.title: Topic framing — 对...来说
lessons.description: Scope an argument to a population or angle

exercises.prompt: Build "For young people, housing prices are unbearable"
exercises.answer: 对 年轻人 来说 ， 房价 已经 难以 承受

exercises.prompt: Which is most formal?
exercises.answer: 对我而言
exercises.explanation: 对...而言 is the formal academic version of 对...来说; both go further than 我觉得.

exercises.prompt: the framing phrase

pairs.right: As far as students are concerned

exercises.prompt: "从长远来看" (cóng cháng yuǎn lái kàn) means "in the ___ run"
exercises.answer: Long

exercises.prompt: Build "In terms of economic efficiency, this plan is the most reasonable"
exercises.answer: 就 经济 效益 而言 ， 这个 方案 最为 合理

exercises.prompt: What does "就这一问题而言，学界尚未达成共识" mean?
options: On this question, academia has not yet reached consensus
exercises.answer: On this question, academia has not yet reached consensus
exercises.explanation: 就...而言 frames the topic; 尚未 ("not yet") is the formal version of 还没.

exercises.prompt: the topic-framing phrase to its register

pairs.right: Neutral, common in speech and writing

exercises.prompt: Complete the formal academic frame: "___ 发展中国家 而言，气候变化是巨大的挑战"
exercises.answer: 对
exercises.explanation: 对...而言 / 就...而言 are both correct; 对 is more common.

exercises.prompt: Spot the register mismatch:
options: 对学生而言，考试压力非常大
对学生来说，考试压力非常大
学生嘛，考试压力对他们而言非常大
就学生而言，考试压力非常大
exercises.answer: 学生嘛，考试压力对他们而言非常大
exercises.explanation: 嘛 is colloquial filler; 而言 is formal. Mixing them sounds jarring. The other three are register-internally consistent.

exercises.prompt: Build "In the long run, education investment will yield enormous returns"
exercises.answer: 从 长远 来看 ， 教育 投入 将 带来 巨大 回报

exercises.prompt: Tap the framing phrase you hear
exercises.spokenText: 对年轻人而言房价已经难以承受
options: 对年轻人而言房价已经难以承受
对年轻人来说房价已经难以承受
对老年人而言房价已经难以承受
对年轻人而言房价已经可以承受
exercises.answer: 对年轻人而言房价已经难以承受
exercises.explanation: Listening at C1: 而言/来说 is register; 年轻人/老年人 is the topic; 难以/可以 inverts polarity.

lessons.title: Citing & paraphrasing
lessons.description: Bring sources into your argument

exercises.prompt: the citation phrase
Build "The data show that population is rising year by year"
exercises.answer: 数据 表明 ， 人口 正在 逐年 上升

exercises.prompt: What does "众所周知" (zhòng suǒ zhōu zhī) mean?
options: It is well known to all
exercises.answer: It is well known to all
exercises.explanation: Literally "what the masses all know" — a fixed academic opener.

exercises.prompt: "研究表明" (yán jiū biǎo míng) means "research ___"
exercises.answer: Shows

exercises.prompt: Tap the connective you hear
exercises.spokenText: 因此我们得出以下结论
options: 因此我们得出以下结论
由此我们得出以下结论
因为我们得出以下结论
于是我们得出以下结论
exercises.answer: 因此我们得出以下结论
exercises.explanation: 因此 ("therefore") and 由此 ("from this") both link cause to result, but 因此 fronts the conclusion while 由此 fronts the inference path. Train your ear to catch the difference.

exercises.prompt: the citation style to its function
Pick the most academic phrasing for "according to the latest research":
exercises.answer: 根据最新的研究
exercises.explanation: 根据 ("based on") + 研究 + neutral nominalization is the academic standard. The others are casual or hedged.

exercises.prompt: Build "As Professor Wang has pointed out, this view warrants further investigation"
exercises.answer: 正如 王 教授 所 指出 的 ， 这 一 观点 值得 进一步 研究

exercises.prompt: Peer-review hedge: "该论文 ___ 一定的创新性，但论证仍可加强" (has a certain degree of)
exercises.answer: 具有
exercises.explanation: 具有/具备一定的 X 是 standard peer-review hedge — you grant a degree without overstating.

exercises.prompt: What does "该研究为后续工作奠定了基础" mean?
options: This research lays the foundation for follow-up work
exercises.answer: This research lays the foundation for follow-up work
exercises.explanation: 奠定基础 = lay the foundation — fixed academic praise.

exercises.prompt: Build "The data show that over the past decade urbanization has accelerated significantly"
exercises.answer: 数据 表明 ， 过去 十年 间 城市化 进程 显著 加快

lessons.title: Hedging & qualifying
lessons.description: Soften claims like a careful scholar

exercises.prompt: Which phrase hedges a generalization the most?
exercises.answer: 在一定程度上
exercises.explanation: 在一定程度上 ("to a certain extent") signals a partial / qualified claim.

exercises.prompt: Build "This phenomenon seems to be related to climate change"
exercises.answer: 这 一 现象 似乎 与 气候 变化 有关

exercises.prompt: the hedge to its function
"据说" (jù shuō) introduces a claim attributed to others — "___" in English
exercises.answer: It is said

exercises.prompt: Which sentence is the most cautious academic claim?
options: 结果绝对证明气候变化加速
结果在一定程度上表明气候变化可能加速
结果表明气候变化加速
结果说明气候变化必然加速
exercises.answer: 结果在一定程度上表明气候变化可能加速
exercises.explanation: 在一定程度上 + 可能 stacks two hedges. 绝对/必然/必将 over-claim; 表明 alone is moderate.

exercises.prompt: Build "Generally speaking, this approach has some validity"
exercises.answer: 总的 来说 ， 这种 方法 在 一定 程度 上 是 有效 的

exercises.prompt: the hedge to its strength
Pick the near-synonym distinction:
options: 我深信 (firm conviction) > 我认为 (current view) > 我以为 (mistaken prior)
exercises.answer: 我深信 (firm conviction) > 我认为 (current view) > 我以为 (mistaken prior)
exercises.explanation: Strength gradient: 我深信 (deeply believe) > 我坚信 ≈ 我认为 > 我觉得 > 我以为 (was mistaken). Mishearing flips the message.

exercises.prompt: Tap the hedged claim you hear
exercises.spokenText: 这一现象似乎与气候变化有关
options: 这一现象似乎与气候变化有关
这一现象肯定与气候变化有关
这一现象似乎与气候变化无关
这一现象一定与气候变化有关
exercises.answer: 这一现象似乎与气候变化有关
exercises.explanation: 似乎/肯定/一定 sit at very different hedge levels. 有关/无关 inverts polarity.

exercises.prompt: Build "To a certain extent, this view has its rationale, but it still needs further verification"
exercises.answer: 在 一定 程度 上 ， 这 一 观点 有 其 道理 ， 但 仍 需 进一步 验证

exercises.prompt: Soften the strong claim: "该方案绝对可行" → "该方案 ___ 可行" (in a certain way)
exercises.answer: 或许
exercises.explanation: 或许/可能/似乎/在一定程度上 all soften the assertion.

lessons.title: Presenting research
lessons.description: Open, signpost, and conclude a talk

exercises.prompt: Build "Today I want to discuss three main findings"
exercises.answer: 今天 我 想 讨论 三 个 主要 发现

exercises.prompt: the signpost to its function
What does "综上所述" (zōng shàng suǒ shù) mean?
exercises.answer: To summarize the above
exercises.explanation: Standard academic transition leading into the conclusion section.

exercises.prompt: "谢谢大家，欢迎提问" closes a talk and means "thank you all, ___ for questions"
exercises.answer: Welcome

exercises.prompt: the thesis-section name to its function
Which line best opens an academic talk?
options: 今天我想跟大家分享我们最近的研究成果
我说啊，最近做了点东西
听好了，今天讲我的论文
exercises.answer: 今天我想跟大家分享我们最近的研究成果
exercises.explanation: 分享研究成果 + 跟大家 = warm but academic. The other three drift toward casual or hostile.

exercises.prompt: Build "To summarize the above, our research has three main findings"
exercises.answer: 综上 所述 ， 我们 的 研究 有 三 个 主要 发现

exercises.prompt: Tap the closing transition you hear
exercises.spokenText: 综上所述这一假设得到验证
options: 综上所述这一假设得到验证
综上所述这一假设遭到否定
总而言之这一假设得到验证
总的来说这一假设得到验证
exercises.answer: 综上所述这一假设得到验证
exercises.explanation: 综上所述/总而言之/总的来说 are register-graded summarizers. 得到验证 / 遭到否定 inverts the conclusion.

exercises.prompt: Pick the correct signpost order in a talk:
exercises.answer: 首先...其次...最后
exercises.explanation: 首先 → 其次 → 再次 (optional) → 最后 is the canonical sequence.

exercises.prompt: Complete: "由此 ___，环境保护至关重要" (we can see / it follows that)
exercises.answer: 可见
exercises.explanation: 由此可见 fronts a concluding inference. 不难看出 is a near-synonym.

exercises.prompt: Build "Thank you for listening, your questions and feedback are most welcome"
exercises.answer: 感谢 各位 的 聆听 ， 欢迎 大家 提问 与 指正

lessons.title: 把…当作 / 视…为 — "regard X as Y"
lessons.description: Frame an entity as something else for analysis

exercises.prompt: What does "我们把语言当作一种工具" mean?
options: We treat language as a tool
exercises.answer: We treat language as a tool
exercises.explanation: 把 X 当作 Y = "take X to be Y / regard X as Y". A core academic framing.

exercises.prompt: Build "This article regards education as the foundation of social mobility"
exercises.answer: 这 篇 文章 把 教育 视为 社会 流动 的 基础

exercises.prompt: the framing pattern to its register

pairs.right: Neutral, common in speech and writing

exercises.prompt: Complete the formal version: "我们 ___ 数据 视 ___ 决策的依据" (regard data as the basis for decisions)
exercises.answer: 把 为
exercises.explanation: 把/将 X 视为 Y is the formal academic frame; 把 X 当作 Y is the neutral cousin.

exercises.prompt: Build "This article regards the development of artificial intelligence as the central question of our era"
exercises.answer: 本文 将 人工 智能 的 发展 视为 这 一 时代 的 核心 问题

exercises.prompt: Spot the register mismatch:
options: 本文将语言视为一种社会工具
我们把语言看成一种工具
我们将语言看成一种工具呗
本研究将语言视为一种交际工具
exercises.answer: 我们将语言看成一种工具呗
exercises.explanation: 将 + 视/看成 lean formal; 呗 is a casual sentence-final particle. The other three keep register internally consistent.

exercises.prompt: Tap the framing you hear
exercises.spokenText: 我们将教育视为社会流动的基础
options: 我们将教育视为社会流动的基础
我们把教育当作社会流动的基础
我们把教育看成社会流动的基础
我们将教育看成社会流动的基础
exercises.answer: 我们将教育视为社会流动的基础
exercises.explanation: 将...视为 is the most formal academic register; 把...当作 is neutral; 看成 is casual.

exercises.prompt: Convert casual "我们把它当成宝" into academic register: "我们 ___ 视 ___ 珍宝"
exercises.answer: 将 为

exercises.prompt: What does "该研究将文化视为一种动态结构" mean?
options: This study regards culture as a dynamic structure
exercises.answer: This study regards culture as a dynamic structure
exercises.explanation: 将 X 视为 Y = treat X as Y. 动态结构 = dynamic structure.

exercises.prompt: Build "Some scholars regard climate change as the greatest challenge of the 21st century"
exercises.answer: 一些 学者 将 气候 变化 视为 二十 一 世纪 最 大 的 挑战

lessons.title: 由此可见 / 不难看出 — drawing inferences
lessons.description: Lead the reader to your conclusion

exercises.prompt: What does "由此可见" (yóu cǐ kě jiàn) signal in academic writing?
options: From this we can see / it follows that
exercises.answer: From this we can see / it follows that
exercises.explanation: 由此可见 hands the reader a conclusion drawn from the evidence just presented.

exercises.prompt: the inference phrase

pairs.right: From this it can be seen
It is not hard to see

exercises.prompt: Build "It is not hard to see that this trend will continue"
exercises.answer: 不难 看出 ， 这 一 趋势 将 持续

exercises.prompt: Complete: "___ ，教育对经济发展至关重要" (from this it can be seen that...)
exercises.answer: 由此可见
exercises.explanation: 由此可见 fronts a concluding inference.

exercises.prompt: Build "From this it can be seen that the demographic trend has profoundly affected the economy"
exercises.answer: 由此 可见 ， 人口 趋势 对 经济 产生 了 深远 影响

exercises.prompt: Which inference signal is the most cautious?
exercises.answer: 可以认为
exercises.explanation: 可以认为 ("one can argue") softens the inference. 由此可见 is moderate; 毫无疑问 / 必然 over-claim.

exercises.prompt: Tap the inference phrase you hear
exercises.spokenText: 不难看出这一趋势将持续
options: 不难看出这一趋势将持续
不难看出这一趋势将停止
由此可见这一趋势将持续
可想而知这一趋势将持续
exercises.answer: 不难看出这一趋势将持续
exercises.explanation: 不难看出/由此可见/可想而知 are near-synonyms with subtle differences. 持续/停止 inverts the prediction.

exercises.prompt: the inference connector to its sense

pairs.right: From this it can be seen

exercises.prompt: Complete the editorial conclusion: "___ 否认，气候变化已成为全人类共同的挑战" (cannot be denied)
exercises.answer: 无可
exercises.explanation: 无可否认 / 毋庸置疑 are interchangeable strong-claim openers.

exercises.prompt: Build "It is not hard to see that, faced with this challenge, the international community must cooperate further"
exercises.answer: 不难 看出 ， 面对 这 一 挑战 ， 国际 社会 必须 进一步 合作

lessons.title: Dialogue: Thesis defense Q&A
lessons.description: Defend your methodology under formal academic scrutiny

exercises.prompt: Your committee chair is questioning your thesis methodology.

turns.speaker: prof
turns.text: 请先简述本研究的核心论点及其学术意义。
turns.spokenText: 请先简述本研究的核心论点及其学术意义

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: State the core argument formally — use 旨在
options: 本研究旨在揭示社交媒体对青年价值观之形塑作用。
我这篇论文就是说社交媒体怎么影响年轻人的。
turns.answer: 本研究旨在揭示社交媒体对青年价值观之形塑作用。

turns.speaker: prof
turns.text: 然而你的样本量仅有三百人，是否足以支持如此宽泛的结论？
turns.spokenText: 然而你的样本量仅有三百人，是否足以支持如此宽泛的结论

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: Fill in the formal causal frame: "the reason ... is because ..."
turns.after: 采用三百人样本，是因为侧重深度访谈而非统计推断。
turns.answer: 之所以

turns.speaker: prof
turns.text: 那么你如何回应质性研究普遍存在的主观性问题？
turns.spokenText: 那么你如何回应质性研究普遍存在的主观性问题

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: Concede then defend — pick the register-appropriate reply
options: 主观性确实难以避免，然而本研究通过三角验证以增强信度。
对啊主观就主观呗，我尽量客观了。
嗯主观是有点，但是没办法嘛。
turns.answer: 主观性确实难以避免，然而本研究通过三角验证以增强信度。

turns.speaker: prof
turns.text: 三角验证的具体操作是什么？请举一例。
turns.spokenText: 三角验证的具体操作是什么？请举一例

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: Use 其 — formal third-person possessive ("its / their")
turns.before: 访谈、问卷与日志三者互证，
turns.answer: 其

turns.speaker: prof
turns.text: 理论框架方面，你为何舍弃哈贝马斯而采用布尔迪厄？
turns.spokenText: 理论框架方面，你为何舍弃哈贝马斯而采用布尔迪厄

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: Justify the choice — academic register with 而
options: 布尔迪厄之惯习概念更契合青年群体之实践逻辑，而非公共领域之话语结构。
我觉得布尔迪厄比较好用一些。
哈贝马斯太老了所以我换了。
turns.answer: 布尔迪厄之惯习概念更契合青年群体之实践逻辑，而非公共领域之话语结构。

turns.speaker: prof
turns.text: 答辩到此。委员会将另行通知评议结果。
turns.spokenText: 答辩到此，委员会将另行通知评议结果

lessons.title: Urbanization
lessons.description: Migration, megacities, and growing pains

exercises.prompt: the term to its meaning
Build "Urbanization has brought enormous economic benefits"
exercises.answer: 城市化 给 经济 带来 了 巨大 的 好处

exercises.prompt: What does "大城市的房价居高不下" mean?
options: Big-city housing prices remain stubbornly high
Houses are cheap in big cities
exercises.answer: Big-city housing prices remain stubbornly high
exercises.explanation: 居高不下 is a fixed expression meaning "stay high and not come down".

exercises.prompt: "农民工" (nóng mín gōng) refers to ___ workers from the countryside
exercises.answer: Migrant

exercises.prompt: What does "城乡差距" describe?
exercises.answer: Urban-rural divide
exercises.explanation: 城乡 (cheng-xiang) = urban-rural; 差距 = gap.

exercises.prompt: Build "In view of the problems brought by urbanization, the government has rolled out a series of policies"
exercises.answer: 鉴于 城市化 带来 的 问题 ， 政府 出台 了 一 系列 政策

exercises.prompt: the urbanization-discourse term
Tap the headline you hear
exercises.answer: 大城市房价居高不下
exercises.explanation: Listening for fixed expressions: 居高不下 vs 持续下降 inverts the trend; 房价 vs 房租 changes the topic.

exercises.prompt: Pick the editorial-grade phrasing for "the wealth gap continues to widen":
options: 贫富差距正在持续扩大
穷人和富人差距越来越大
有钱的越有钱没钱的越没钱
exercises.answer: 贫富差距正在持续扩大
exercises.explanation: 贫富差距 + 持续扩大 = formal editorial register. The others are conversational.

exercises.prompt: Complete: "___ 而言，户口制度对劳动力流动构成了限制" (in terms of social mobility, ...)
exercises.answer: 就社会流动
exercises.explanation: 就...而言 fronts the topic; 户口制度 = household registration system.

exercises.prompt: Build "Although urbanization brings opportunities, it also gives rise to a series of problems"
exercises.answer: 城市化 虽然 带来 机遇 ， 但 也 引发 了 一 系列 问题

lessons.title: Aging society
lessons.description: Demographics, retirement, and care

exercises.prompt: the demographic term
What does "少子化" (shǎo zǐ huà) mean?
exercises.answer: Declining birth rate / fewer children
exercises.explanation: Coined from Japanese, becoming common in Chinese policy discussions; mainland writing still tends toward 出生率下降.

exercises.prompt: Build "China's population is aging rapidly"

guide.intro: Classical Chinese threads through modern writing in three little words: 之, 其, 所. They look intimidating but they're not new grammar — they're compressed forms of structures you already know. Recognize them and most literary and academic Chinese opens up.

sections.text: 之 — the literary 的
之 (zhī) is what 的 used to be. In modern Chinese it survives in fixed expressions and titles. Wherever you see 之, mentally substitute 的. The structure 名词 + 之 + 名词 = "X's Y" or "Y of X".

rows.pinyin: Zhōngguó zhī měi
rows.translation: The beauty of China (= 中国的美)

rows.pinyin: Chénggōng zhī dào
rows.translation: The path to success

rows.pinyin: Zǒng ér yán zhī
rows.translation: All in all ("to sum up and speak of it")

rows.pinyin: Yì jǔ liǎng dé zhī shì
rows.translation: Something that kills two birds with one stone

sections.text: 其 — "its / their / his / her"
其 (qí) is the literary third-person possessive — equivalent to 它的 / 他的 / 她的 / 他们的, depending on context. You'll meet it in essays, instructions, and idioms.

rows.pinyin: Qí jiéguǒ lìng rén zhènjīng.
rows.translation: Its (the) result is shocking.

rows.pinyin: Gōngsī jí qí yuángōng
rows.translation: The company and its employees

rows.pinyin: Yóuqí
rows.translation: Especially ("particularly its [case]")

rows.pinyin: Gè qǔ qí suǒ xū
rows.translation: Each takes what they need

sections.text: 所 — turning verbs into nouns

所 (suǒ) sits before a verb to nominalize the object: 所 + 动词 = "that which is V-ed". The full pattern is often 名词 + 所 + 动词 + 的 + 名词 = "the X that N V's". It feels ancient but appears constantly in titles and formal speech.

rows.pinyin: Wǒ suǒ kàndào de
rows.translation: What I have seen (literally: that which I saw)

rows.pinyin: Wǒmen suǒ zuò de nǔlì
rows.translation: The efforts we have made

rows.pinyin: Zhòng suǒ zhōu zhī
rows.translation: As is universally known

rows.pinyin: Lǐ suǒ dāng rán
rows.translation: As reason dictates / naturally

sections.text: You almost never need to write 之/其/所 yourself in everyday Chinese. The goal is recognition: when you see 其, your brain swaps in 它的; when you see 所...的, you read it as "the thing that is V-ed".

lessons.title: Classical traces — 之 / 其

exercises.prompt: In "中国之美", 之 functions as ___

Rewrite "该书及它的译本" in literary register: "该书及 ___ 译本"
exercises.answer: 其
exercises.explanation: 其 = 它的 — the literary possessive used in formal writing.

topics.title: News & journalism
topics.description: Read headlines, parse op-eds, follow current events

guide.intro: News Chinese is its own dialect — short, dense, and heavy with cause-effect connectives. Two patterns dominate explanatory writing: 之所以 X 是因为 Y for reverse-order causation, and 不仅 X 而且 Y for stacking points. Get fluent in these and headlines stop being puzzles.

sections.text: 之所以...是因为 — effect first, cause second

Standard order is 因为 X 所以 Y ("because X, so Y"). When you want to lead with the surprising effect and explain it after, flip to 之所以 Y 是因为 X ("the reason Y is because X"). It's a hallmark of essay and op-ed Chinese.

rows.source: 他之所以成功，是因为他从不放弃。
rows.pinyin: Tā zhī suǒ yǐ chénggōng, shì yīnwèi tā cóng bù fàngqì.
rows.translation: The reason he succeeded is that he never gave up.

rows.source: 中国之所以发展迅速，是因为改革开放的政策。
rows.pinyin: Zhōngguó zhī suǒ yǐ fāzhǎn xùnsù, shì yīnwèi gǎigé kāifàng de zhèngcè.
rows.translation: China developed rapidly because of the reform and opening-up policy.

sections.text: 不仅...而且 — "not only... but also"
不仅 X 而且 Y stacks points: not only X, but also Y. The formal form is 不但 X 而且 Y; the literary form 不仅...更 ramps up the second clause.

rows.source: 这部电影不仅获得了好评，而且票房火爆。
rows.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng bùjǐn huòdé le hǎopíng, érqiě piàofáng huǒbào.
rows.translation: This film not only got good reviews but also did huge box office.

rows.source: 他不仅是一位作家，更是一位思想家。
rows.pinyin: Tā bùjǐn shì yí wèi zuòjiā, gèng shì yí wèi sīxiǎngjiā.
rows.translation: He is not only a writer but, even more so, a thinker.

sections.text: Headline grammar
Headlines compress hard. They drop pronouns, particles, and even verbs. Learn these high-frequency journalist verbs and you'll skim headlines in seconds.
据 X 报道 — quick refresher

You met 据报道 at B2, so this is a refresher rather than new ground. At C1, focus on the variants: 据 X 报道 attributes to a named source, while 据悉 ("it is learned") is the unsourced, slightly official cousin. Both anchor the start of a sentence.

rows.source: 据新华社报道，会议将于下周举行。
rows.pinyin: Jù Xīnhuáshè bàodào, huìyì jiāng yú xiàzhōu jǔxíng.
rows.translation: According to Xinhua News Agency, the meeting will be held next week.

rows.source: 据悉，相关部门正在调查此事。
rows.pinyin: Jù xī, xiāngguān bùmén zhèngzài diàochá cǐ shì.
rows.translation: It is learned that the relevant departments are investigating the matter.

exercises.prompt: the verb to its meaning
Pick the most natural news translation: "The government rolled out a new policy."
exercises.answer: 政府出台了新政策

exercises.prompt: Build the headline-style "The two countries signed a trade agreement"
exercises.answer: 两 国 签署 贸易 协议

exercises.prompt: "据新华社报道" means "according to ___"
exercises.answer: Xinhua

exercises.prompt: Tap the headline you hear
exercises.answer: 两国签署贸易协议
exercises.explanation: Headlines drop particles and lean on a tight verb. Listen for 签署 (sign) vs neighbors like 宣布 (announce) and 谴责 (condemn).

exercises.prompt: What does the compressed headline "央行降准 释放流动性" mean?
options: Central bank cuts reserve ratio, releases liquidity
Central bank raises rates, tightens liquidity
The central bank issues new currency
exercises.answer: Central bank cuts reserve ratio, releases liquidity

exercises.prompt: the headline verb to its meaning
Build the compressed headline "China and EU sign new climate cooperation agreement"
exercises.answer: 中 欧 签署 新 气候 合作 协议

exercises.prompt: the headline verb: "国务院 ___ 楼市新政" (rolls out new housing policy)
exercises.answer: 出台
exercises.explanation: 出台 ("roll out") is the standard verb for launching policies.

exercises.prompt: Pick the strongest condemnation verb:
exercises.answer: 谴责
exercises.explanation: 谴责 ("condemn") is the strongest; 批评 ("criticize") is moderate; 指出 / 评论 are neutral.

exercises.prompt: Tap the headline you hear
exercises.answer: 央行宣布降息
exercises.explanation: 降息/加息/降准 — three different monetary moves. 宣布/公布 also a register dial.

lessons.title: 之所以…是因为
lessons.description: Effect first, cause second

exercises.prompt: Build "The reason he succeeded is that he never gave up"
exercises.answer: 他 之所以 成功 ， 是因为 他 从不 放弃

exercises.prompt: What does "她之所以受欢迎，是因为她真诚" mean?
options: She wants to be popular and so is sincere
The reason she is popular is that she is sincere
She is popular because she pretends
exercises.answer: The reason she is popular is that she is sincere

exercises.prompt: Which sentence uses 之所以...是因为 correctly?
options: 我之所以学中文，是因为我喜欢中国文化
我之所以是因为学中文喜欢
因为我喜欢中国文化之所以学中文
exercises.answer: 我之所以学中文，是因为我喜欢中国文化

exercises.prompt: Complete: "中国 ___ 发展迅速，是因为改革开放"
exercises.answer: 之所以
exercises.explanation: 之所以 fronts the effect; 是因为 introduces the cause.

exercises.prompt: Build "The reason this policy has caused widespread controversy is that it touches on many people's interests"
exercises.answer: 这 项 政策 之所以 引发 广泛 争议 ， 是因为 它 触及 了 许多 人 的 利益

exercises.prompt: What does "该现象之所以普遍，是因为社会结构的深层原因" mean?
options: The reason this phenomenon is widespread is the deep structural causes of society
The phenomenon is rare due to structure
The phenomenon and structure are unrelated
exercises.answer: The reason this phenomenon is widespread is the deep structural causes of society

exercises.prompt: the cause-and-effect frame to its order

pairs.left: 因为 X 所以 Y
之所以 Y 是因为 X
由于 X 因此 Y
鉴于 X 因此 Y

exercises.prompt: Tap the op-ed opener you hear
exercises.spokenText: 他之所以受欢迎是因为他真诚
options: 他之所以受欢迎是因为他真诚
他之所以受欢迎是因为他幽默
她之所以受欢迎是因为她真诚
他因为真诚所以受欢迎
exercises.answer: 他之所以受欢迎是因为他真诚
exercises.explanation: Listen for 他/她, 真诚/幽默, and the connective frame 之所以...是因为 vs 因为...所以.

exercises.prompt: Spot the register mismatch:
options: 他之所以成功，是因为他从不放弃
他之所以成功，那是因为他贼能扛
他之所以成功，归根结底是因为他坚持不懈
他之所以备受推崇，是因为他始终秉持原则
exercises.answer: 他之所以成功，那是因为他贼能扛
exercises.explanation: 之所以...是因为 is a formal op-ed frame; 贼 (Northeast slang for "super") and 能扛 (colloquial "can endure") clash with it.

exercises.prompt: Complete: "该计划 ___ 失败，是因为执行不力" (the reason it failed)
exercises.answer: 之所以
exercises.explanation: 之所以 fronts the surprising effect.

exercises.prompt: Build "The reason rural areas are losing population is that opportunities are concentrated in big cities"
exercises.answer: 农村 之所以 人口 流失 ， 是因为 机会 集中 于 大 城市

lessons.title: 不仅...而且 — stacking arguments
lessons.description: Add weight without losing flow

exercises.prompt: Build "This plan is not only feasible but also efficient"
exercises.answer: 这个 方案 不仅 可行 而且 高效

exercises.prompt: What does "他不仅是作家，更是思想家" emphasize?
options: Both are true, but the second is the bigger point
exercises.answer: Both are true, but the second is the bigger point
exercises.explanation: 更 ("even more so") amplifies the second clause.

exercises.prompt: the connective to its register
Complete: "这本书 ___ 内容丰富，___ 文笔优美" (not only...but also)
exercises.answer: 不仅 而且

exercises.prompt: Build "This policy not only impacts the economy, but more importantly, it reshapes social structure"
exercises.answer: 这 项 政策 不仅 影响 经济 ， 更 重要 的 是 ， 它 重塑 了 社会 结构

exercises.prompt: What does "既...又..." emphasize compared with "不仅...而且..."?
options: Parallel coexistence of two qualities (both X and Y)
exercises.answer: Parallel coexistence of two qualities (both X and Y)
exercises.explanation: 既...又... = parallel; 不仅...而且... = additive escalation.

exercises.prompt: Tap the connective you hear
exercises.spokenText: 他不仅是一位作家更是一位思想家
options: 他不仅是一位作家更是一位思想家
他不仅是一位作家而且是一位思想家
他既是一位作家又是一位思想家
他不但是一位作家而且是一位思想家
exercises.answer: 他不仅是一位作家更是一位思想家
exercises.explanation: 更 amplifies the second clause; 而且 just adds; 既...又 puts them in parallel. C1 listening discriminates these subtle gear shifts.

exercises.prompt: Pick the most editorial-grade phrasing:
options: 该方案不仅切实可行，更具有深远的战略意义

exercises.explanation: 切实可行 / 深远的战略意义 = formal editorial collocations.

exercises.prompt: Complete: "这部电影 ___ 获得好评，___ 票房火爆" (literary 'not only...even more so')

guide.intro: Persuasive Chinese has its own choreography: state your premise, acknowledge the counter-argument, then refute. Three structures power the dance — conditionals (要是...就/便, 即使...也), the concessive 虽然...但是, and the rhetorical 难道...吗.

sections.text: Conditionals

rows: As long as X, then Y
除非 X 否则 Y

rows.source: 要是你早点告诉我就好了。
rows.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ zǎo diǎn gàosù wǒ jiù hǎo le.
rows.translation: If only you had told me earlier.

rows.pinyin: Jíshǐ xiàyǔ, wǒmen yě yào qù.
rows.translation: Even if it rains, we are still going.

rows.source: 只要你努力，就一定会成功。
rows.pinyin: Zhǐyào nǐ nǔlì, jiù yídìng huì chénggōng.
rows.translation: As long as you work hard, you will surely succeed.

rows.source: 除非他道歉，否则我不会原谅他。
rows.pinyin: Chúfēi tā dàoqiàn, fǒuzé wǒ bú huì yuánliàng tā.
rows.translation: Unless he apologizes, I will not forgive him.

sections.text: 虽然...但是 — concede then push back
The strongest debaters concede. 虽然 X 但是 Y ("although X, but Y") signals you've heard the counterpoint and have an answer. Formal upgrade: 尽管 X，然而 Y.

rows.source: 虽然这个方案有风险，但是收益也很大。
rows.pinyin: Suīrán zhège fāng'àn yǒu fēngxiǎn, dànshì shōuyì yě hěn dà.
rows.translation: Although this plan has risks, the returns are also large.

rows.source: 尽管成本上升，然而公司仍然盈利。
rows.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn chéngběn shàngshēng, rán'ér gōngsī réngrán yínglì.
rows.translation: Although costs rose, the company is nevertheless still profitable.

sections.text: 难道...吗 — rhetorical question
难道 ("could it really be that") fronts a question to which the speaker assumes the answer is obvious. Used to challenge an assumption or rebuke.

rows.pinyin: Nándào nǐ bù zhīdào ma?
rows.translation: Could it be that you don't know? (You should know!)

rows.pinyin: Nándào zhè jiù shì dá'àn ma?
rows.translation: Is this really the answer?

sections.text: In writing, balance your concessives. A column that opens with 虽然...但是 and closes with 难道...吗 reads as classic argumentative Chinese.

lessons.title: Stating your position
lessons.description: Open with confidence

exercises.prompt: the opener
Build "In my view, this view is one-sided"
exercises.answer: 在 我 看来 这个 观点 比较 片面

exercises.prompt: Which is most formal for "I firmly believe"?
exercises.answer: 我坚信
exercises.explanation: All four are plausible C1 alternatives, but 坚信 ("firmly believe") is the strongest and most formal — 深信 is close behind, 相信 is neutral, 认定 leans toward "conclude / be convinced".

exercises.prompt: "毫无疑问" (háo wú yí wèn) means ___
exercises.answer: Without a doubt

exercises.prompt: Tap the verb of belief you hear
exercises.answer: 我认为这个方案可行
exercises.explanation: 认为 ("hold the view that") states a current belief; 以为 ("used to think / mistakenly thought") implies the speaker has since changed their mind. Mishearing one for the other flips the meaning.

exercises.prompt: Pick the strongest gradient ordering for verbs of belief:
options: 我深信 > 我坚信 > 我认为 > 我觉得 > 我以为 (mistaken)
我以为 > 我深信 > 我认为
我觉得 > 我深信 > 我以为
exercises.answer: 我深信 > 我坚信 > 我认为 > 我觉得 > 我以为 (mistaken)
exercises.explanation: Strength gradient runs from firm conviction to casual impression to mistaken prior view.

exercises.prompt: Build "In my humble view, this view, although appealing, is somewhat one-sided"
exercises.answer: 依 我 之 见 ， 这 一 观点 虽 具 吸引力 ， 但 略 显 片面

exercises.prompt: the position-marker to its register
Complete the formal opener: "在 ___ 看来，这一现象值得深思" (in our view)
exercises.answer: 我们
exercises.explanation: 在我们看来 / 在我看来 = formal opinion frame.

exercises.prompt: Spot the register mismatch in this debate opener:
options: 依我之见，该方案存在严重缺陷
依我之见，这玩意儿压根不行
在我看来，这个方案存在缺陷
我认为该方案需要进一步完善
exercises.answer: 依我之见，这玩意儿压根不行
exercises.explanation: 依我之见 is literary; 这玩意儿/压根 are colloquial. Mixing them sounds jarring.

exercises.prompt: Tap the strength of conviction you hear
exercises.answer: 我深信这一观点
exercises.explanation: 我深信 / 我坚信 / 我相信 / 我认为 sit at four points on the strength dial. C1 listening discriminates them.

exercises.answer: 只要 你 努力 ， 就 一定 会 成功

exercises.prompt: the conditional
Complete: "___ 他道歉，否则我不会原谅他" (Unless...)
exercises.answer: 除非

exercises.prompt: Build "Even if there are setbacks along the way, we will not give up"
exercises.answer: 即使 途 中 遭遇 挫折 ， 我们 也 不会 放弃

exercises.prompt: What does "假如换个角度看，问题或许更清晰" mean?
options: If we look from another angle, the problem may be clearer
exercises.answer: If we look from another angle, the problem may be clearer
exercises.explanation: 假如 = formal "should / suppose"; 或许 = soft hedge "perhaps".

exercises.prompt: the conditional to its strength
Complete: "___ 你愿意倾听，对方就会愿意沟通" (As long as)
exercises.answer: 只要
exercises.explanation: 只要 X 就 Y — sufficient-condition frame.

exercises.prompt: Tap the conditional you hear
exercises.spokenText: 除非他先道歉否则我们不会让步
options: 除非他先道歉否则我们不会让步
除非他先道歉否则我们一定让步
只要他先道歉我们就会让步
如果他先道歉我们就会让步
exercises.answer: 除非他先道歉否则我们不会让步

exercises.explanation: 假如 + 便 + 激增 = formal economic-reasoning register.

exercises.prompt: Build "Even if it takes ten years, this goal still warrants the effort"
exercises.answer: 即使 需要 十 年 ， 这个 目标 仍 值得 我们 努力

lessons.title: Concede & refute
lessons.description: 虽然...但是 / 尽管...然而

exercises.prompt: Build "Although this plan has risks, the returns are large"
exercises.answer: 虽然 这个 方案 有 风险 ， 但是 收益 很 大

exercises.prompt: Which is the most formal version of "although...however"?
exercises.answer: 尽管...然而

exercises.prompt: Pick the sentence that concedes a point and pushes back:
options: 你说得有道理，但是我们也要看到另一面
exercises.answer: 你说得有道理，但是我们也要看到另一面

exercises.prompt: "你说得有道理" means "what you say is ___"
exercises.answer: Reasonable

exercises.prompt: What does the rebuttal structure "诚然...然而..." express?
options: Concede a point genuinely, then turn against it
exercises.answer: Concede a point genuinely, then turn against it
exercises.explanation: 诚然 ("granted / it is true that") + 然而 = a debater's classic concede-and-pivot.

exercises.prompt: the rebuttal opener
Tap the concession marker you hear
exercises.spokenText: 尽管成本上升然而公司仍然盈利
options: 尽管成本上升然而公司仍然盈利
虽然成本上升但是公司仍然盈利
尽管成本下降然而公司仍然盈利
尽管成本上升然而公司开始亏损
exercises.answer: 尽管成本上升然而公司仍然盈利
exercises.explanation: 尽管/虽然 differ in register; 上升/下降 inverts cause; 盈利/亏损 inverts result.

exercises.prompt: Spot the register mismatch in this concede-and-rebut:
options: 尽管对方观点有合理之处，然而问题在于其忽视了长期影响
尽管你说的没错啊，但是问题在于这玩意儿没用
诚然，该方案有其优势，然而风险亦不容忽视
话虽如此，仍需考虑实际操作的可行性
exercises.answer: 尽管你说的没错啊，但是问题在于这玩意儿没用
exercises.explanation: 尽管 lean formal; 你说的没错啊 / 这玩意儿没用 are casual. Mixed register sounds inconsistent.

exercises.prompt: Convert casual "虽然有问题但是值得尝试" to formal: "___ 存在 不足 ， ___ 仍 值得 尝试"
exercises.answer: 尽管 然而
exercises.explanation: 尽管...然而 is the formal upgrade of 虽然...但是.

exercises.prompt: Build "That said, we still need to consider its impact on small and medium-sized enterprises"
exercises.answer: 话 虽 如此 ， 我们 仍 需 考虑 其 对 中小 企业 的 影响

lessons.title: Rhetorical questions — 难道...吗

exercises.prompt: What does "难道你不知道吗？" really mean?

exercises.answer: An accusation — surely you know!

exercises.prompt: Build the rhetorical "Could this really be the only solution?"
exercises.answer: 难道 这 是 唯一 的 解决 办法 吗

exercises.prompt: the rhetorical opener
"难道你忘了吗？" implies you ___ have forgotten
exercises.answer: Shouldn't

exercises.prompt: Build the rhetorical "If even this is not a problem, then what could possibly be a problem?"
exercises.answer: 如果 这 都 不 算 问题 ， 那 还有 什么 算 问题 呢

exercises.prompt: What does "试问，谁能在此情况下保持冷静？" really argue?

exercises.answer: Nobody could stay calm under such circumstances

难道我们就这样坚持吗
难道你们就这样放弃吗
我们难道这样放弃了吗
exercises.answer: 难道我们就这样放弃吗
exercises.explanation: Listen for 我们/你们 (we/you), 放弃/坚持 (give up/persist), and word order — all classic C1 traps.

exercises.prompt: Pick the literary rhetorical "how could we possibly tolerate this?":
exercises.answer: 我们岂能容忍此事

exercises.answer: 难道

exercises.answer: 如此 多 的 警告 ， 我们 岂 能 视而 不见

topics.title: Chéngyǔ in context
topics.description: Eight high-frequency four-character idioms used the right way

guide.intro: 成语 (chéngyǔ) are four-character idioms that compress a story or principle into one phrase. There are thousands of them, but only a few hundred are actually high-frequency. We'll meet eight that you'll see weekly in news, conversation, and writing — and learn the contexts where each lands well.

sections.text: How idioms slot into sentences

成语 typically work as adjectives, adverbs, or full predicates. Most can stand alone as a four-character verb phrase: 一举两得 ("two birds, one stone") can be the whole verb. Some need a 是 or 的 frame to slot in: 这是一举两得的事.

rows.pinyin: Zhè zhēn shì yì jǔ liǎng dé.
rows.translation: This really is killing two birds with one stone.

rows.pinyin: Tā gōngzuò bàn tú ér fèi.
rows.translation: He gave up halfway through the work.

rows.pinyin: Jǐn shàng tiān huā de shèjì
rows.translation: An icing-on-the-cake design

sections.text: Eight to remember

rows: Win-win solution / two birds, one stone
Help when help is most needed
Enter the village, follow its customs
When in Rome, do as the Romans

sections.text: 锦上添花 vs 雪中送炭
These two are taught as a pair. 锦上添花 is help when things are already good — nice but not vital. 雪中送炭 is help in a crisis — the kind people remember forever. Pick the right one when praising someone.

rows.pinyin: Nǐ zhè shì xuě zhōng sòng tàn, xièxie!
rows.translation: This is help when I really needed it — thank you!

rows.source: 不算什么，只是锦上添花。
rows.pinyin: Bú suàn shénme, zhǐshì jǐn shàng tiān huā.
rows.translation: It's nothing, just a small bonus.

sections.text: Don't pile 成语 on top of 成语. One per paragraph in writing, one per minute in speech. Used sparingly they sound elegant; used densely they sound like a textbook.

lessons.title: Win-win — 一举两得
lessons.description: And its sibling 一石二鸟

exercises.prompt: What does "一举两得" literally mean?
exercises.answer: One action, two gains
exercises.explanation: 一举 = one move; 两得 = two gains.

exercises.prompt: Build "This plan is really a two-birds-one-stone solution"
exercises.answer: 这个 方案 真是 一举两得

exercises.prompt: Which situation best fits "一举两得"?
options: Walking the dog AND getting exercise
exercises.answer: Walking the dog AND getting exercise

exercises.prompt: "一石二鸟" is the equivalent of "___ stone, two birds"
exercises.answer: One

exercises.prompt: the idiom to its classical story

pairs.right: Han-era essay: one move gains two ends
Tale of throwing one stone to fell two birds
Mencius: half the effort, double the result
Mencius: fish and bear-paw can rarely both be had

exercises.prompt: Pick the literal-vs-figurative distinction for 一举两得:
options: Literal: 'one lift, two gains'; Figurative: 'achieve two aims with one action'
It only has a literal meaning
It only has a figurative meaning
exercises.answer: Literal: 'one lift, two gains'; Figurative: 'achieve two aims with one action'
exercises.explanation: 一举 literally means 'one lift / one move'; 两得 literally means 'two gains'. The modern figurative use is 'kill two birds with one stone'.

exercises.prompt: Build the headline-style "Renewable energy: economic and environmental two-birds-one-stone"
exercises.answer: 可再生 能源 ： 经济 与 环保 一举两得

exercises.prompt: Complete the news context: "骑车上下班 ___，既环保又锻炼" (kills two birds with one stone)
exercises.answer: 一举两得
exercises.explanation: 一举两得 fits a benefit-stacking situation perfectly.

exercises.prompt: Tap the idiom you hear
exercises.answer: 这真是一举两得
exercises.explanation: All four start with 一. Listen for 举两得 (action, two gains) vs 无所获 (no gain) vs 鸣惊人 (sudden fame) vs 蹴而就 (achieved at one go).

exercises.prompt: Spot the misused 成语:
options: 他每天跑步上班，既锻炼了身体又节省了交通费，真是一举两得
他下班后回家做饭，真是一举两得
他失败了，真是一举两得
我们既能学习又能赚钱，可谓一举两得
exercises.answer: 他失败了，真是一举两得
exercises.explanation: 一举两得 requires two positive outcomes from one action. Pairing it with simple failure is a misuse.

exercises.prompt: Build "This policy can not only stimulate the economy but also create jobs — truly a two-birds-one-stone solution"
exercises.answer: 这 项 政策 不仅 能 刺激 经济 ， 还 能 创造 就业 ， 实 为 一举两得

lessons.title: Quitting halfway — 半途而废
lessons.description: And the opposite: 坚持不懈

exercises.prompt: What does "半途而废" describe?
exercises.answer: Giving up halfway

exercises.prompt: Build "Don't give up halfway, persistence brings success"
exercises.answer: 不要 半途而废 ， 坚持 才 能 成功

exercises.prompt: the idiom to its meaning
"坚持不懈" — 不懈 means "without ___"
exercises.answer: Slacking

exercises.prompt: Pick the literal-vs-figurative distinction for 半途而废:
options: Literal: 'on the road, halfway, then abandoned'; Figurative: 'give up halfway through'
It only has a literal meaning
It only has a figurative meaning
exercises.answer: Literal: 'on the road, halfway, then abandoned'; Figurative: 'give up halfway through'
exercises.explanation: 半途 = halfway on the road; 而废 = and abandon. Story comes from the 礼记 tale of the wife who cuts her unfinished weaving to teach her husband not to quit study.

exercises.prompt: Build "If we give up halfway now, all our previous efforts will be in vain"
exercises.answer: 如果 现在 半途而废 ， 之前 所有 的 努力 都 将 前功尽弃

exercises.prompt: Complete the editorial: "科研之路漫长，唯有 ___ 方能有所突破" (perseverance)
exercises.answer: 坚持不懈
exercises.explanation: 唯有 X 方能 Y = formal "only by X can one Y". 坚持不懈 fits the long-haul mission perfectly.

exercises.prompt: Tap the idiom you hear
exercises.answer: 他工作半途而废
exercises.explanation: 半途而废 (give up halfway) vs 坚持不懈 (persevere) — opposite qualities. 全力以赴 (give it all) and 前功尽弃 (waste prior effort) are different shades.

exercises.prompt: Spot the misused 成语:
options: 他攻读博士四年，从未半途而废
他买了菜，吃完了，真是半途而废
项目刚到一半就停了，等于半途而废
exercises.answer: 他买了菜，吃完了，真是半途而废
exercises.explanation: 半途而废 requires giving up an unfinished task. Eating bought food to completion is finishing, not abandoning halfway.

exercises.prompt: the perseverance idiom to its meaning
Build "As long as we persevere, we will surely reach our goal"
exercises.answer: 只要 我们 坚持不懈 ， 就 一定 能 达到 目标

lessons.title: 锦上添花 vs 雪中送炭
lessons.description: Bonus help vs critical help

exercises.prompt: A friend lends you money when you're broke. They are providing ___
exercises.answer: 雪中送炭
exercises.explanation: 雪中送炭 = help in a crisis — "sending charcoal in the snow".

exercises.prompt: Adding extra dessert to an already-feast is ___
exercises.answer: 锦上添花
exercises.explanation: Already-good situation + bonus = "adding flowers to brocade".

exercises.prompt: Build "What you did was truly help in time of need"
exercises.answer: 你 这 真 是 雪中送炭

exercises.prompt: "锦" originally means ___ — fine brocade silk
exercises.answer: Brocade
exercises.explanation: 锦 specifically refers to brocade or patterned silk — distinct from 绣 (embroidery).

exercises.prompt: Build "At the most difficult moment, your help was truly help in time of need"
exercises.answer: 在 我 最 困难 的 时候 ， 你 的 帮助 真是 雪中送炭

exercises.prompt: Pick the right idiom: a wealthy company donates to disaster relief — bystanders praise this as ___
exercises.answer: 雪中送炭
exercises.explanation: Disaster victims are in crisis — 雪中送炭 fits. 锦上添花 would suggest the recipients were already fine.

exercises.prompt: Complete: "她已经够优秀了，这次得奖只能算 ___" (icing on the cake)
exercises.answer: 锦上添花
exercises.explanation: 锦上添花 fits when the recipient is already in a good state.

exercises.prompt: Tap the idiom you hear
exercises.answer: 你这是雪中送炭
exercises.explanation: 雪中送炭 (crisis help) vs 锦上添花 (bonus help) — context-critical pair to discriminate.

exercises.prompt: Pick the literal-vs-figurative distinction for 锦上添花:
options: Literal: 'add flowers atop brocade'; Figurative: 'make a good thing better'
It only has a literal meaning
It only has a figurative meaning
exercises.answer: Literal: 'add flowers atop brocade'; Figurative: 'make a good thing better'
exercises.explanation: 锦 = brocade silk; 添花 = add flowers. Already-fine becomes finer.

exercises.prompt: the help-related idiom to its meaning

pairs.right: Bonus on top of an already-good thing
Kick someone when they are down

exercises.prompt: Build "In view of the disaster, donations from all sides have served as help in time of need"
exercises.answer: 鉴于 灾情 严重 ， 各方 捐赠 无异 于 雪中送炭

lessons.title: When in Rome — 入乡随俗
lessons.description: And a couple cousins for adapting

exercises.prompt: What does "入乡随俗" mean?
options: When in Rome, do as the Romans
exercises.answer: When in Rome, do as the Romans

exercises.prompt: Build "In a foreign country we should follow local customs"
exercises.answer: 在 外国 我们 应该 入乡随俗

exercises.prompt: the cultural-fit idiom
"乡" in 入乡随俗 originally means ___
exercises.answer: Village

exercises.prompt: Pick the literal-vs-figurative distinction for 入乡随俗:
options: Literal: 'enter the village, follow its customs'; Figurative: 'when in Rome, do as Romans do'
It only has a literal meaning
It only has a figurative meaning
exercises.answer: Literal: 'enter the village, follow its customs'; Figurative: 'when in Rome, do as Romans do'

exercises.prompt: Build "Doing business overseas, we should adapt to local customs and respect local culture"
exercises.answer: 在 海外 经营 ， 我们 应 入乡随俗 ， 尊重 当地 文化

exercises.prompt: Complete the news context: "跨国企业管理须 ___，方能融入本地市场" (adapt to local customs)
exercises.answer: 入乡随俗
exercises.explanation: 入乡随俗 = mandatory cultural adaptation, formal context.

exercises.prompt: Tap the idiom you hear
exercises.spokenText: 在外国我们应该入乡随俗
options: 在外国我们应该入乡随俗
在外国我们应该顺其自然
在外国我们应该因地制宜
在外国我们应该随遇而安
exercises.answer: 在外国我们应该入乡随俗
exercises.explanation: Four cultural-fit idioms that overlap but aren't identical. 入乡随俗 specifically follows local customs.

exercises.prompt: Pick the right idiom: a city plans transit lines according to its hilly terrain. They are practicing ___
exercises.answer: 因地制宜
exercises.explanation: 因地制宜 ("tailor measures to local conditions") fits planning to terrain. 入乡随俗 is about cultural conformity.

exercises.prompt: the adaptation idiom to its scenario
Build "Doing business in China, foreign companies must adapt to local customs to gain trust"
exercises.answer: 外国 企业 在 中国 经营 ， 须 入乡随俗 方能 赢得 信任

lessons.title: Down-to-earth — 脚踏实地 / 实事求是
lessons.description: Praise for pragmatism

exercises.prompt: What does "脚踏实地" describe a person as?
exercises.answer: Down-to-earth and steady
exercises.explanation: Literally "feet planted on solid ground".

exercises.prompt: Build "He is down-to-earth and works very steadily"
exercises.answer: 他 脚踏实地 工作 非常 稳

exercises.prompt: What does "实事求是" mean?
options: Seek truth from facts / be pragmatic
exercises.answer: Seek truth from facts / be pragmatic
exercises.explanation: Famous phrase often associated with Deng Xiaoping's pragmatism.

exercises.prompt: "不可思议" (bù kě sī yì) means literally "cannot be ___"
exercises.answer: Conceived
exercises.explanation: Modern use: "unbelievable / inconceivable".

exercises.prompt: Pick the literal-vs-figurative distinction for 实事求是:
options: Literal: 'in real things, seek what is so'; Figurative: 'be pragmatic, fact-based'
It only has a literal meaning
It only has a figurative meaning
exercises.answer: Literal: 'in real things, seek what is so'; Figurative: 'be pragmatic, fact-based'

topics.title: Abstract & philosophical
topics.description: Talk about ideas, ethics, fate, and meaning

guide.intro: Modern Mandarin still leans on a small cluster of fate-and-cause vocabulary inherited from Confucian, Buddhist, and Daoist thought. Three words do most of the work: 缘分 (fated connection), 因果 (cause and effect), and 命运 (destiny). They aren't religious jargon — speakers use them every day to talk about relationships, outcomes, and choices. Learning the cultural framing keeps you from translating them too flatly.

sections.text: 缘分 — the right people, the right time

缘分 (yuán fèn) names the unseen tie that brings two people, or a person and a place, together. It's used loosely in romance ("we have 缘分"), friendship ("我们很有缘"), and even chance encounters. The Buddhist root is 缘 ("condition that gives rise to a meeting"); the modern register is warm, slightly fatalistic, and very common.

rows.source: 我们能再见面，真是缘分。
rows.pinyin: Wǒmen néng zài jiànmiàn, zhēn shì yuán fèn.
rows.translation: That we could meet again is truly fate.

rows.pinyin: Yǒu yuán qiān lǐ lái xiāng huì.
rows.translation: If fated, even a thousand miles can't keep two from meeting.

rows.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì jiù suí yuán ba.
rows.translation: Let's just let this one go where fate takes it.

sections.text: 因果 — cause and effect

因果 (yīn guǒ) literally pairs 因 (cause) with 果 (fruit / result). In Buddhist usage it names karma; in modern speech it works as a neutral "cause and effect" — useful in argument, science writing, and ethics talk alike. The four-character expression 因果报应 ("karmic retribution") keeps the moral edge.

rows.pinyin: Fán shì dōu yǒu yīn guǒ.
rows.translation: Every event has a cause and an effect.

rows.source: 我们要分析这件事的因果关系。
rows.pinyin: Wǒmen yào fēnxī zhè jiàn shì de yīn guǒ guānxi.
rows.translation: We need to analyse the causal relationship of this matter.

rows.pinyin: Zhòng shàn yīn, dé shàn guǒ.
rows.translation: Plant good causes, reap good fruits.

sections.text: 命运 — destiny you can argue with

命运 (mìng yùn) is destiny, but with more give than the English word suggests. Speakers talk about 改变命运 ("change one's destiny") and 与命运抗争 ("struggle against fate") freely — destiny is fixed enough to name, fluid enough to push against. Adjacent terms: 天命 (heavenly mandate, more solemn), 宿命 (predetermined fate, fatalistic).

rows: Neutral; can be changed in modern usage

sections.text: These words sit in everyday conversation, not just temples. A friend who lands a job they nearly missed will say 这就是缘分; a parent reflecting on a child's path will say 改变命运. Don't over-translate them as "karma" or "fate" — let the context pick the English.

lessons.title: Complements — 得 / 不 / 完 / 光 / 掉 / 破

exercises.prompt: What does "这么多菜我吃不完" mean?

I can't possibly finish so many dishes
I have not eaten the dishes
I am still eating the dishes
exercises.answer: I can't possibly finish so many dishes
exercises.explanation: 吃不完 is the potential complement: V + 不 + 完 = "unable to finish V-ing". Positive form: 吃得完 ("can finish").

lessons.title: Separable verbs — 离合词
lessons.description: 见过面, 帮了一个忙, 结过婚

exercises.prompt: Why is "我见面他了" wrong?
options: 见面 is a separable verb — the object goes in the middle: 我见过他的面 / 我跟他见过面
见面 only takes a time word
exercises.answer: 见面 is a separable verb — the object goes in the middle: 我见过他的面 / 我跟他见过面
exercises.explanation: Separable verbs (离合词) like 见面, 帮忙, 结婚 are V-O compounds. You can't tack a second object on; aspect markers and modifiers go between the two halves.

exercises.prompt: the separable-verb form to its sense

exercises.prompt: Which sentence is correct?
exercises.answer: 我们见过两次面
exercises.explanation: With 离合词, the experience marker 过 follows the verb-half (见), and the count phrase splits the compound: 见过两次面.

exercises.prompt: Pick the correct separable-verb form for "I have been worried for three days":

exercises.prompt: the 离合词 to its split form
Tap the correct separable-verb form you hear

exercises.explanation: 帮 + 了 + indirect-object + 一个 + 大 + 忙 — the 离合词 splits cleanly.

exercises.prompt: Convert "我们见面三次了" into the correct 离合词 form: "我们见 ___ 三次面 ___"
exercises.answer: 了 了
exercises.explanation: 见过/了 + 三次 + 面 + 了 — duration splits the compound.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence shows correct separable-verb negation?
exercises.answer: 我没结过婚
exercises.explanation: 没 + 结 + 过 + 婚 — 没 sits before the verb-half, 过 follows the verb-half.
